summary.en: Ethiopian military drones have crossed into Sudan, prompting formal complaints from Sudan at the UN and the African Union. The WHO warns that the health system in northern Ethiopia is near collapse as attacks on civilians continue, including an RPG strike near a school in Moyale that killed 60 Ethiopian Orthodox believers. Kenya has begun registering over 50,000 Ethiopian refugees fleeing the Moyale clashes. The conflict has already caused 2,824 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Etiopiske militærdroner har krysset inn i Sudan, noe som har ført til formelle klager fra Sudan ved FN og Den afrikanske unionen. WHO advarer om at helsesystemet i Nord-Etiopia er nær kollaps mens angrep på sivile fortsetter, inkludert et RPG-angrep nær en skole i Moyale som drepte 60 etiopiske ortodokse troende. Kenya har begynt å registrere over 50 000 etiopiske flyktninger som flykter fra sammenstøtene i Moyale. Konflikten har allerede forårsaket 2 824 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: War in Amhara
background.extract: The War in Amhara is an armed war and insurgency in the Amhara Region of Ethiopia that began in April 2023 between the Fano militia and the Ethiopian government. The conflict started after the government attempted to dissolve the Amhara Special Forces and other regional forces as part of a plan to reform and centralize the country's security apparatus, and integrate them into the federal armed forces. This move led to protests and armed resistance by local forces under Fano.
